segments.name: Nextdoor
segments.description: Neighborhood network connecting verified neighbors with locally relevant content, services, news, safety alerts, recommendations, and advertising solutions.
segments.evidence: Nextdoor is the essential neighborhood network connecting over 105 million Verified Neighbors to the people, places, and information that matter most in their local communities.

revenueModel.text: Businesses and advertisers pay for targeted advertising solutions to reach local audiences through self-serve and managed advertising campaigns on the platform.
revenueModel.evidence: Our Nextdoor Ads Platform is built on a proprietary ad stack that includes the Nextdoor Ads Manager interface, our native ad server, and measurement and API tools.

changes.text: In 2025, Nextdoor launched a product transformation initiative, the first phase of a multi-phase evolution expanding the platform beyond neighbor-generated content to include timely locally relevant information enriched with AI and ML.
changes.evidence: In 2025, we launched the new Nextdoor initiative, the first phase of a multi‑phase product transformation designed to create more engaging experiences for neighbors and partners and deliver enhanced value for advertisers.
